desc: The Crosman Vapor Max is a .177 variable pump air rifle that lets you adjust power by changing the number of pumps. It delivers up to 1100 fps with alloy pellets and up to 900 fps with lead pellets, producing up to 14 foot-pounds of energy. A bolt-action design pairs with a rifled barrel and includes two 10-shot auto-indexing magazines to keep shooting moving. Fiber optic front and adjustable rear sights, plus a dovetail rail, round out this synthetic-stock platform.
